question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

LANGUID
solution: The correct answer is '**energetic**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word 'Languid' means **'weak or faint from illness or fatigue; (of a person, manner, or gesture) having or showing a disinclination for physical exertion or effort.**' (बीमारी या थकान से कमजोर या बेहोश; (किसी व्यक्ति, तरीके, या हावभाव का) शारीरिक परिश्रम या प्रयास के प्रति उदासीनता होना या दिखाना**)** • The antonyms of the word '**Languid**' are 'ambitious, animated, energetic, enterprising, motivated'. • From the antonyms of the given word, we can say that the word 'Energetic' is the opposite in meaning. • The word 'Energetic' means **'****showing or involving great activity or vitality.' **(ऊर्जावान) Hence, the correct answer is option 2. Let's see the meaning of other given options:- Words Meaning Lethargic affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathetic. (सुस्ती से प्रभावित; सुस्त और उदासीन) Sluggish slow-moving or inactive. (धीमी गति से चलने वाला या निष्क्रिय) Indolent wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy. (गतिविधि या परिश्रम से बचना चाहते हैं; काम चोर) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The synonyms of the word 'Languid' are 'enervated, lackadaisical, languishing, languorous, limp, listless, spiritless'. • Example of 'Languid____' in a sentence:__ • *A slow, **languid** smile crossed his features, one that made her body flush and ache for him.* d3:Tda6, The correct answer is 'BCAD'.
